levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عدي بن خيار

notes: «وقال بشر بن شعيب» opens a second isnad carrying the same saying (rule 4): its own group.
«تابعه إسحاق الكلبي حدثني الزهري مثله» is a follower naming another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route.
Uthman is the last link: the words after «فتشهد» are his (rule 6, as in the «هانئ» example). «دخلت على عثمان» is Ubayd Allah's scene.
